The CryptoPro CSP license will be included only in your 1C Reporting certificate. CryptoPro CSP will not work with other certificates (without an embedded license). <link https://1c-report.ru/1c-report-kriptopro>Details</><link Подробнее...>... </>Each time you reissue a certificate with an embedded license, you have to make an additional license payment.
Scanned copy of passport of the certificate holder

If you extend a certificate and/or license by digitally signing the application, attach the scanned copy.
Double-page spread with a photo. The original or a certified copy.
Scanned copy requirements: - File format: jpeg, png, pdf - File size: up to 10 MB - Image quality: 150-400 dpi - Color
Scanned copies should be taken from the original documents or from their certified copy. Certifying inscription should contain the following items: - The "TRUE COPY" inscription - Position and a company name - Signature with blue ball pen - Print name - Document assurance date - Blue seal
Facsimile cannot be used instead of signature.
Приложите скан-копию, если изменились паспортные данные владельца сертификата и планируется подписать заявление эл. подписью.
